steps.name: validate-previously-built-exact-sha
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ef1a903a74dfd3df588f7598fa378126c55865c6"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test -s frontend/dist/index.html
echo MAC_RELEASE_INDEX_SHA
shasum -a 256 frontend/dist/index.html
grep -oE '/assets/[^"]+[.](js|css)' frontend/dist/index.html | head -n 15

steps.name: save-rollback-ui-and-online-sqlite
steps.command:
ssh -i /Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "90609f7733b178da9f2687e2133c64b47fb7338b"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
systemctl is-active --quiet photomap.service
systemctl is-active --quiet cloudflared.service
curl -fsS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null
release=".dev/deploy/2026-11-09-compact-drawer-ef1a903"
test ! -e "$release"
mkdir -p "$release"
cp -a frontend/dist "$release/dist-before"
git rev-parse HEAD > "$release/source-before.sha"
sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html > "$release/index-before.sha256"
systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value > "$release/backend-pid-before"
systemctl show cloudflared.service -p MainPID --value > "$release/tunnel-pid-before"
python3 - "$release" <<'PY'
import pathlib, sqlite3, sys
release = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
db = pathlib.Path("backend/data/app.db")
if not db.is_file(): raise SystemExit("missing database")
with sqlite3.connect(f"file:{db.resolve()}?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=30) as origin:
    with sqlite3.connect(release / "app-before.db", timeout=30) as copy:
        origin.backup(copy)
        assert copy.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0] == "ok"
print("SQLITE_SNAPSHOT_OK", (release / "app-before.db").stat().st_size)
PY
test -s "$release/dist-before/index.html"
echo "BACKUP_READY=$release"
REMOTE

steps.name: fast-forward-pi-source
steps.command:
ssh -i /Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "90609f7733b178da9f2687e2133c64b47fb7338b"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "ef1a903a74dfd3df588f7598fa378126c55865c6"
git merge --ff-only origin/main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ef1a903a74dfd3df588f7598fa378126c55865c6"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "PI_SOURCE=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
REMOTE

steps.name: stage-hashed-frontend-assets
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ef1a903a74dfd3df588f7598fa378126c55865c6"
test -s frontend/dist/index.html
export RSYNC_RSH='ssh -i /Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8'
rsync -az --exclude=index.html frontend/dist/ michal@192.168.0.23:/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/frontend/dist/
rsync -az frontend/dist/index.html michal@192.168.0.23:/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/frontend/dist/index.html.next
echo STAGED
shasum -a 256 frontend/dist/index.html

steps.name: atomic-index-cutover
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
expected="$(shasum -a 256 frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')"
ssh -i /Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 bash -s -- "$expected" "ef1a903a74dfd3df588f7598fa378126c55865c6" <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
expected="$1"
target="$2"
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
release=".dev/deploy/2026-11-09-compact-drawer-ef1a903"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$target"
test -s "$release/app-before.db"
test -s "$release/dist-before/index.html"
test -s frontend/dist/index.html.next
test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html.next | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected"
systemctl is-active --quiet photomap.service
systemctl is-active --quiet cloudflared.service
test "$(systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$(cat "$release/backend-pid-before")"
test "$(systemctl show cloudflared.service -p MainPID --value)" = "$(cat "$release/tunnel-pid-before")"
mv -f frontend/dist/index.html.next frontend/dist/index.html
if ! test "$(sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | awk '{print $1}')" = "$expected" || ! curl -fsS --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null; then
  cp -p "$release/dist-before/index.html" frontend/dist/index.html.rollback
  mv -f frontend/dist/index.html.rollback frontend/dist/index.html
  echo ROLLBACK_ACTIVATED >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo LIVE_INDEX
sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html
echo LIVE_SHA
git rev-parse HEAD
echo RUNNING_PIDS
systemctl show photomap.service cloudflared.service -p MainPID
REMOTE

steps.name: public-smoke-no-dynamic-html-hash-assumption
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ef1a903a74dfd3df588f7598fa378126c55865c6"
app="$(grep -oE '/assets/index-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+[.]js' frontend/dist/index.html | head -n 1)"
style="$(grep -oE '/assets/index-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+[.]css' frontend/dist/index.html | head -n 1)"
map="$(find frontend/dist/assets -maxdepth 1 -name 'public-map-*.js' | head -n 1)"
test -n "$app" && test -n "$style" && test -f "$map"
tmp="$(mktemp /tmp/photomap-public-release.XXXXXX)"
curl -fsS --max-time 20 -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' 'https://photomap.pl/?ux=ef1a903' -o "$tmp"
grep -Fq "$app" "$tmp"
grep -Fq "$style" "$tmp"
echo "PUBLIC_HTML_REFERENCES=$app $style"
curl -fsS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w 'APP_JS_HTTP=%{http_code}\\n' "https://photomap.pl$app"
curl -fsS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w 'CSS_HTTP=%{http_code}\\n' "https://photomap.pl$style"
curl -fsS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w 'MAP_JS_HTTP=%{http_code}\\n' "https://photomap.pl/assets/$(basename "$map")"
curl -fsS --max-time 15 'https://photomap.pl/health'
echo
curl -fsS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w 'API_HTTP=%{http_code}\\n' 'https://photomap.pl/api/places/map'
ssh -i /Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519 -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 michal@192.168.0.23 'cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps && git status --short --branch && git rev-parse HEAD && sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html && systemctl is-active photomap.service cloudflared.service && systemctl show photomap.service cloudflared.service -p MainPID'
